Ava Li: Quick sync — we need to finalize the API response contract for v1.3. Customers repeatedly ask for clearer mapping between operational failures (rate limits, model unavail) and user-facing guidance. Can we agree scope and launch criteria today? :eyes:

Rajat Singh: Scope proposal: cover chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, and function/tool-calling. For v1.3 target: canonical error classes + status code mappings + SDK retry hints.

Priya Nair: Top customer asks from CS: 1) Distinguish rate_limit vs quota_exceeded; 2) structured-output validation errors (schema mismatch) with field-level hints; 3) deterministic fallback when model unavailable (which model variant to route to).

Tom Baxter: Draft taxonomy (suggested): rate_limit, quota_exceeded, validation_error, auth_error, model_unavailable, partial_generation, tool_invocation_error, transient_infra, deprecated_model. Each maps to HTTP status + machine-readable `code` in body + human `message`.

Tom Baxter: Example mapping:
```
HTTP 429 -> code: rate_limit.exceeded -> retry_after (s)
HTTP 403 -> code: quota.exceeded -> quota_window
HTTP 400 -> code: validation.schema_mismatch -> errors: [{path, message}]
HTTP 503 -> code: model.unavailable -> fallback: [model-id]
HTTP 207 -> code: partial.success -> details
```

Priya Nair: For structured output, customers want field-level errors rather than opaque 400s. Recommend `errors` array with JSON-pointers.

Rajat Singh: Launch criteria proposal: docs + examples, SDK surface updates with retry helpers, e2e test for each error class, one reference customer validated (CS sig-off). If any auth or security changes -> enterprise review required.

ops-bot: Note: infra currently returns 503 for GPU OOM and 502 for container crash. Consider normalizing to `model.unavailable` with more detail.

Ava Li: Decision: include taxonomy above in v1.3, but postpone quota-based rate shaping policies to v1.4. Owners: Tom (spec), Priya (CS validation), Rajat (SDK). Due EOD next Thu. @CustomerSuccessBot please line up reference customer.

Priya Nair: I'll draft example of schema-mismatch payload by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Tom Baxter: I'll add machine-readable `code` namespace rules and add sample SDK retry hint objects.

Rajat Singh: I'll add tests and a migration guide for existing clients.

Ava Li: Thanks — I'll add this to the roadmap doc and flag as customer-driven priority. If anyone has objections, speak now. Otherwise will ship spec PR Monday. :rocket:
